description: [Wicked Reputation] Pay out every unbonding stake whose cooldown has elapsed, in one on-chain transfer to your wallet. Safe to retry if a payout fails. Needs a signed nonce.

nonce.description: Nonce from a FRESH reputation_get_nonce call.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature (EIP-191) over that nonce's message, from YOUR wallet.

name: reputation_withdraw
